data.description: The person who is walking with you is the most important person in your life.
The size of the animal you see represents the perception you have about the size of your problems.
The degree of interaction you have with the animal represents how you handle your problem problems, i.e., If you are passive or active to a problem.
The size of the house of your dreams represents how ambitious you are solve your problems.

If you don't see any grating, indicates that you are a very open person. For you, people are welcome at any time and at all times. On the other hand, the presence of a grate in the house indicates a closed personality. In this case, you are one of those people who would prefer not to receive any visit that you've not been waiting.
If in the table you saw no food, people or flowers, then generally you are an unhappy person.

The durability of the material of the cup represents the how you present the durability of the relationship that you keep with the person of the number 1 answer. For example, if you saw a cup of dry ice, plastic or paper, then it is a disposable relationship. But if on the other hand, if your cup is metal or ceramic, then you perceive the relationship as very durable.
What you have decided to do with the cup represents your attitude towards the person named in the answer number 1.
The size of the water body you saw represents the size of your sexual desire.
How much you are wet when crossing the water indicates the relative importance of your sexual life.
